title: Complete up, but not what I was expecting
body: As an app, Ultiself is well designed and offers a lot of valuable content. However, it requires a significant amount of discipline and time to get the most out of it. It wasn’t really what I was looking for. I was expecting something more like Duolingo for quitting alcohol, with a more guided and interactive approach. Instead, it’s a system that requires you to actively track and engage with it throughout the day. That said, the customer service was very good when I requested a refund.
